title: Reagan proposes SDI at a cabinet meeting
summary: John Harrington tells of Reagan proposes SDI at a cabinet meeting, about 1983 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> And he said, "Look, wouldn't it be wonderful at a cabinet meeting if we could design something that would protect us from missiles?"

plain: John Harrington, presented as a former US Secretary of Energy, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 1983 cabinet meeting at the White House that he says he attended. He says President Ronald Reagan asked whether it wouldn't be wonderful to design something that could protect the country from missiles. That idea became the Strategic Defense Initiative, or SDI, a plan to shoot down enemy missiles.
